title: DAGOS Jev Context Classification v1
description: Jev's entire output: one classification label per node. Jev only classifies context membership, so the contract has no room for plans, routes, provider choices, tool calls, actions, or prose. Each node_id must be a candidate from the request and appear at most once; candidates Jev leaves out keep their current membership.

classification.description: active: the node belongs in the run's active context. inactive: it does not; the durable node is unaffected.
